howto: Press Play. Pick LEVELS (a tower with a finish and three stars) or ENDLESS (the old depth and gems run).
Tap (or press Space) to smash the platform under the ball; tap again while falling to slam through.
The dark parts are deadly: aim the ball at a colour. Slamming several platforms in a row builds a slam streak.
Reach the gold star to clear the level; the three stars are: reach the finish, hit the slam-streak goal, finish under the par time.
Coins buy ball skins; new balls also unlock from stars, levels and day streaks.
tips: Wait for a gap in the dark part before you tap: each platform spins at its own speed.
A slam streak of five earns a bonus.
Every five levels the tower changes world and gets longer with more dark parts.
A daily goal (gems, platforms, slams or levels) pays coins once a day; playing on consecutive days lights the week stamps.

controls.keyboard: Space or Down arrow smashes, press again in the air to slam. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap anywhere to smash, tap again in mid-air to slam

difficulty: Level N has 12+2N platforms (up to 70), up to five deadly parts per platform (two at first, one more every six levels), a faster spin as N grows and a new world every five levels. Endless keeps the adaptive curve.

cheats.effect: Steel ball: black parts break like the rest
Slow spin: platforms turn at half speed
Big ball: a giant ball that grabs gems from further away

features.one-tap-start: Play, then the first tap smashes and starts the run
features.instant-restart: Play Again on the Cracked card starts a new run at once
features.best-score-badge: Best pill in the top bar during play, and on the Cracked card
features.tutorial-card: Get-ready card with a tapping finger; the first run also explains slams and black parts
features.results: Result card with stars, score, coins, gems, best and Next Level
features.levels: LEVELS mode with a level picker and stars per level
features.stars: Three stars per level (finish, slam-streak goal, par time)
features.worlds: Five worlds with their own palette (Terracotta, Rose Garden, Deep Sea, Ember Night, Sandy Cove)
features.unlocks: Nine ball skins: free, stars, coins, level or day-streak unlocks
features.daily-goal: One seeded daily goal with a coin reward, week stamps and a day streak

settings.quality: Title screen > GRAPHICS: HIGH / LOW (Low renders at 1x resolution with no shadows, draws 6 platforms below the ball instead of 11 and fewer shards)
